name: Goodbye, My Home
source:
Agustín is at the airport, waiting to board the plane that will take him to his new life. While he waits, he ponders on the situation, his desire to stay and the circumstances that make it difficult.

[From [url=https://floramisu.itch.io/goodbye-my-home]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿古斯丁身处机场，等待登上一架载他前往新生活的航班。在候机的间隙，他反复思索着眼下的处境——内心想要留下的渴望，以及迫使他不得不离开的现实无奈。

[摘自[url=https://floramisu.itch.io/goodbye-my-home]itch.io[/url]]
